description: Decodes an x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt and checks Base / Base Sepolia: settlement_confirmed is true only if the tx succeeded and its logs contain a USDC Transfer to the expected payTo (pay_to, else this server's) for the expected amount (amount, else this server's price) from the stated payer. RPC unavailable, unknown network or a receipt without a tx fails (not charged). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Expected amount in USDC base units (default: this server's price when pay_to is this server).

confirm.description: false = decode only, no on-chain check (default true).

pay_to.description: Expected merchant address (default: this server's payTo).

receipt.description: Base64 PAYMENT-RESPONSE value, settlement JSON text, or the object.

name: x402.verify-receipt
title: Verify an x402 settlement on-chain
